_comment: Defense-side deeper-learning policy (backlog #36). Owner decision 2026-06-14: 'PD work + curated live link'. The transform agent emits deeper_learning.defense.pd_work (REQUIRED — a real PD apologetic/harmonizing work that treats THIS contradiction) and optionally deeper_learning.defense.link (a live page, ONLY from an allowlisted domain). This mirrors the critic side's pair (essay source + SAB outbound) so neither side's 'go deeper' is one-sided. Auditor verifies reality + on-topic; auditHarmonization.py checks pd_work presence + that any link domain is on the allowlist.

pd_work_default.resource: John Haley, An Examination of the Alleged Discrepancies of the Bible (1874)
pd_work_default.author: John Haley

pd_work_also_acceptable: Any harmonizing commentator surfaced on the row (Gill, JFB, Clarke, Keil & Delitzsch, Matthew Henry, Geneva, Tyndale) keyed to this passage.
rules: pd_work is REQUIRED on every row — the textual anchor, mirroring the critic essay source.
link is OPTIONAL: include only a real, on-topic page whose domain is on live_link_allowlist; otherwise omit it / set url null. NEVER guess or fabricate a URL.
Both pd_work and any link must genuinely address THIS contradiction — the auditor verifies and will flag invented or off-topic resources.
